Jump Trading Llc decreased its stake in Nvidia Corp (NVDA) by 48.33% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jump Trading Llc sold 15,707 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.21% with the market. The institutional investor held 16,793 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $3.98 million, down from 32,500 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Jump Trading Llc who had been investing in Nvidia Corp for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $174.18 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.00% or $2.88 during the last trading session, reaching $286.48. About 9.16 million shares traded. NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) has risen 58.13% since October 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 42.51% the S&P500.
Jump Trading Llc, which manages about $1.27 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Spdr S&P 500 Etf Tr (Put) (SPY) by 244,600 shares to 787,100 shares, valued at $213.52M in 2018Q2, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Ishares Tr (Put) (EEM) by 95,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 174,400 shares, and has risen its stake in Alphabet Inc (Put).
Analysts await NVIDIA Corporation (NASDAQ:NVDA) to report earnings on November, 8. They expect $1.73 earnings per share, up 30.08 % or $0.40 from last year’s $1.33 per share. NVDA’s profit will be $1.05B for 41.40 P/E if the $1.73 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.77 actual earnings per share reported by NVIDIA Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -2.26 % negative EPS growth.
